scope: Read-only review of new approximation, proven contact split and exact adjacent zero-edge normalization helpers; no existing checks rerun

findings.detail: Derivative bounds assume the documented longitude/latitude graticule ratio formulas, monotone original curve domains and geographic-degree output. The author added this exact contract and finite positive input preconditions. The current private adapter follows this formula.

Piecewise-knot subdivision plus component Hessian bounds and chord error M/8 are conservative in real arithmetic for the documented ratio transform. The 14.534855m composite estimate covers source206 curve flattening plus subsequent chord projection only; it is not a geographic registration or historical-source accuracy claim. Floating-point execution retains the explicit numerical margin and sampled check; this is not formal interval arithmetic certification.

The generic split requires a separately proved exact repeated point, retains every directed edge, and asserts exact Fraction signed-area equality. Opposite winding, unproved self-contact and contact splitting involving holes fail closed. The source113/ocean27 rational endpoint identity is separately evidenced.

The new normalization removes only adjacent occurrences of exactly equal coordinate values. Nonzero directed-edge multisets, all distinct coordinate values and exact rational signed area are asserted unchanged. It does not snap, move coordinates, remove short nonzero edges, or repair arbitrary invalid geometry.
README wording was narrowed from a general holes fail-closed claim to contact splitting involving holes. Full geometric validity remains a separate OGR/AreaCore check.
Reviewed generic helpers contain no original map assets, historical control coordinates, city anchors, event dates, source-specific renderer, or deployment actions.

limits: Approval applies only to the exact reviewed generic helper bytes. Later edits require a focused diff review.
